items.summary: New updates to ggml/llama.cpp include a new fused operation for QSA mask scoring and the enrollment of glm5.3-next, enhancing tensor initialization in tests to prevent NaN values that could cause test failures. This update impacts developers working on the project by improving tensor handling and ensuring more robust testing environments.
